title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-oke1: lichen-schc crate has 54 compilation errors
description:
The lichen-schc crate fails to compile with 54 errors in fragment.rs and headers.rs. Key issues:

**fragment.rs**: Missing constants (TILE_SIZE, BITMAP_MASK, WINDOW_SIZE, MAX_PACKET_SIZE, MAX_ACK_REQUESTS, RULE_ID_A_TO_B, RULE_ID_B_TO_A). Type mismatches (u8 vs u32 for MAX_ACK_REQUESTS). Missing Debug impl for FragmentSender. Undefined variables (n, body_bytes, tile_size).

**headers.rs**: write_ipv6_header changed signature to accept (u8, u32) tuple for flow parameter but 4 call sites still pass traffic_class and flow_label as separate arguments.

The fuzz target change in the commit (removing tile buffer param from Fragment::from_bytes) is correct in isolation but can't be verified since the crate doesn't compile.
